title: Northgate Delivery & Installation Claim Windows and Installation Workmanship Warranty
content:
Problems found after a completed Northgate Delivery & Installation appointment are reported within windows counted in calendar days after the completion date. Each service level sets four of them: visible merchandise damage, damage found on unpacking, damage to the home, and the period during which a faulty installation is redone free (the installation workmanship warranty).

| Service level | Visible merchandise damage | Damage found on unpacking | Damage to the home | Installation workmanship warranty |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Curbside Delivery | 2 days | 7 days | 7 days | 0 days |
| Northgate Threshold Delivery | 2 days | 7 days | 7 days | 0 days |
| Northgate Room of Choice Delivery | 2 days | 10 days | 7 days | 0 days |
| Northgate White Glove Delivery | 2 days | 10 days | 7 days | 90 days |
| Northgate Appliance Delivery & Installation | 2 days | 30 days | 7 days | 365 days |
| Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation | 2 days | 30 days | 7 days | 365 days |

## Notes

- Visible damage (2 days) and damage to the home (7 days) have the same window at every level.
- The window for damage found on unpacking lengthens with the level: 7 days at Curbside and Threshold, 10 days at Room of Choice and White Glove, 30 days at the two installation levels.
- A workmanship warranty of 0 days means the level offers none; White Glove offers 90 days and the two installation levels 365 days.
